for: Quarterdeck final design PR 3: the Lane tracker (the ruling to the ruling)
author: Quarterdeck contributors
how: 'lanes' holds one tracker per Lane id, merged by Lane id into the example data's lanes. The three standard stages are Plan, Execute, Check; bots may rename, add and remove stages and steps, and l-da1 does (7 stages, 12 steps).

Every field a screen shows is a field here: stage names, marks and times, 'Done when', 'Now' (the data's own `now`, except l-sw2 and l-set, whose restated lines are in addendum-data.json `lanesChanged`), 'Next', blockers (what, who waits, since when, the Task Card it links to), 'Updated <time> by <bot>' and 'Changed by <bot> <time>: <what>'. Strings under `display` are the expected text; the build computes them from the fields and must match.

Every tracker change in `changes` lands in the Lane's Activity: each change has an Activity line with the same time and bot, either an existing line in the example data or a line listed in addendum-data.json `activityAdded`. 'Updated' is the newest Activity line.

'No update for N hours' shows on an Active Lane with no blocker and no Activity line for 2 hours or more. N is whole hours at the example 'now'. Only l-mai is quiet: its last update is Sun 2:00 PM, 20 hours before now.
The Project view has no project-level tracker: `projectView` lists each Lane's own row. Done Lanes fold into 'Done (N)'.
Wording the rulings leave open is marked 'suggested' and is the design lead's call: the date formats, whole hours, the 'Blocked' mark, the count line when no steps exist, where a long mark wraps.
Times are New York time, -04:00 before Sun Nov 1, 2026, 2:00 AM and -05:00 after, as in the example data. Nothing is later than the example 'now'.

rules.rowWidthUnit: characters, counting each of ✓ ● ○ · … as one; the ▸ Stages control is not counted
rules.unfoldedRow: marks and names joined by two spaces, for example '✓ Plan  ● Execute  ○ Check'
rules.foldedRow: '✓ N done · ● <current> · ○ N more'; the current name is cut with '…' so the row is at most 44 characters; a part whose count is 0 is left out (suggested)
rules.countLine: 'Stage S of N · step X of Y: <step name>', the step name cut with '…' so the line is at most 44 characters; 'countLineFull' keeps the whole name
rules.stepLine: when the row does not fold and steps exist: '<stage>, step X of Y: <step name>', at most 44 characters in this data
rules.projectRow: '<stage> (S of N) · step X of Y' with the stage name cut to fit 44 characters, then the mark ('! Waiting on you', '! Blocked: <bot>' or 'No update for N hours') on the same line when it fits and on the next line when it does not (suggested)
rules.timeLabels: same day: '9:50 AM'; within 7 days: 'Sun 6:20 PM'; older: 'Oct 21, 12:00 PM' (suggested; matches seen.json for the first two)
